passage.text: Last month, Nam decided to cancel her gym membership.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ, ˈnɑːm dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə ˈkænsəl hɜːr ˈdʒɪm ˈmɛmbərʃɪp.

passage.text: She was too busy to go, but she was still paying 1,200 baht a month.
passage.reading: ʃiː wʌz ˈtuː ˈbɪzi tə ˈɡoʊ, bʌt ʃiː wʌz ˈstɪl ˈpeɪɪŋ ˌwʌn ˈθaʊzənd ˈtuː ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt ə ˈmʌnθ.

passage.text: "Hello. I'd like to cancel my membership, please," Nam said politely.
passage.reading: həˈloʊ. aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈkænsəl maɪ ˈmɛmbərʃɪp, ˈpliːz, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛd pəˈlaɪtli.

passage.text: "Oh, I'm sorry to hear that," said the man on the phone. "Would you like a free month instead?"
passage.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪm ˈsɑːri tə ˈhɪr ˈðæt, ˈsɛd ðə ˈmæn ɑːn ðə ˈfoʊn. wʊd juː ˈlaɪk ə ˈfriː ˈmʌnθ ɪnˈstɛd?

passage.text: "No, thank you," said Nam. "I just want to cancel."
passage.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈθæŋk juː, ˈsɛd ˈnɑːm. aɪ ˈdʒʌst ˈwɑːnt tə ˈkænsəl.

passage.text: "How about half price for three months?"
passage.reading: ˈhaʊ əˈbaʊt ˈhæf ˈpraɪs fər ˈθriː ˈmʌnθs?

passage.text: "No, thank you," Nam said firmly. "Please cancel it today."
passage.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈθæŋk juː, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛd ˈfɜːrmli. ˈpliːz ˈkænsəl ɪt təˈdeɪ.

passage.text: Then the man said, "I'm afraid we can't cancel memberships by phone. Cancellations must be made in writing."
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ðə ˈmæn ˈsɛd, aɪm əˈfreɪd wiː ˈkænt ˈkænsəl ˈmɛmbərʃɪps baɪ ˈfoʊn. ˌkænsəˈleɪʃənz mʌst bi ˈmeɪd ɪn ˈraɪtɪŋ.

passage.text: Nam was annoyed, but she stayed calm.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm wʌz əˈnɔɪd, bʌt ʃiː ˈsteɪd ˈkɑːm.

passage.text: "Fine. Can I send an email?" she asked.
passage.reading: ˈfaɪn. kən aɪ ˈsɛnd ən ˈiːmeɪl? ʃiː ˈæskt.

passage.text: "Yes, but you have to come to the gym and sign a form, too."
passage.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt juː ˈhæf tə ˈkʌm tə ðə ˈdʒɪm ənd ˈsaɪn ə ˈfɔːrm, ˈtuː.

passage.text: The next day, Nam went to the gym, signed the form and sent an email.
passage.reading: ðə ˈnɛkst ˈdeɪ, ˈnɑːm ˈwɛnt tə ðə ˈdʒɪm, ˈsaɪnd ðə ˈfɔːrm ənd ˈsɛnt ən ˈiːmeɪl.

passage.text: She also asked for a cancellation number.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈæskt fər ə ˌkænsəˈleɪʃən ˈnʌmbər.

passage.text: A week later, the gym took 1,200 baht from her account again!
passage.reading: ə ˈwiːk ˈleɪtər, ðə ˈdʒɪm ˈtʊk ˌwʌn ˈθaʊzənd ˈtuː ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt frəm hɜːr əˈkaʊnt əˈɡɛn!

passage.text: Nam called them and gave them her cancellation number.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ˈkɔːld ðɛm ənd ˈɡeɪv ðɛm hɜːr ˌkænsəˈleɪʃən ˈnʌmbər.

passage.text: This time, they said sorry and gave her the money back.
passage.reading: ðɪs ˈtaɪm, ðeɪ ˈsɛd ˈsɑːri ənd ˈɡeɪv hɜːr ðə ˈmʌni ˈbæk.

passage.text: Be polite, but firm, and always keep a copy of everything.
passage.reading: bi pəˈlaɪt, bʌt ˈfɜːrm, ənd ˈɔːlweɪz ˈkiːp ə ˈkɑːpi əv ˈɛvriθɪŋ.
